declare

 nullchk;

IF is_timezone_enabled and :process_dats is not null THEN
 
 select sysdate into v_sysdate_gmt from dual; 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :process_dats, v_process_dats_gmt);

END IF; -- timezone conversion

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if :Global.Error_count ='N' then 
 :Global.Error_count:='Y';
 if error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) then -- invalid time
 show_error('5016');
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;

Trigger.Name: COMMIT_TRANSACTION
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :process_code = 'THAW'
 then
 begin
 insert into utrs
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, test_seq_no,
 test_id, insert_dats, insert_user_id, program_id)
 select :unit_id, :coll_date, :s_chapter_id, 1,
 test_id, sysdate, :banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name
 from contract_tests
 where contract_id = (select contract_id
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 stop_label_flag = 'Y' and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)
 and not exists
 (select 'x'
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 utrs.test_id =
 contract_tests.test_id and
 cancel_flag is null
 union
 select 'x'
 from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 unit_test_base.test_id =
 contract_tests.test_id and
 cancel_flag is null);
 if sql%found
 then
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from component_attributes
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 attrib_group = 'ALERT' and
 attrib_code = 'REPO';
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0003');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in trying to check for repository samples');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in inserting in UTRs');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 declare
 v_gmt_time date;
 begin
 --- timezone conversion starts
 if is_timezone_enabled and :process_dats is not null then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :process_dats, v_gmt_time);
 insert into component_sp
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, component_prefix,
 product_code, process_code, insert_dats,
 insert_user_id, patient_id, program_id)
 values
 (:unit_id, :coll_date, :s_chapter_id, :component_prefix,
 :product_code, :process_code, v_gmt_time, :banner.user_id,
 :patient_id, :banner.prog_name);
 else
 --- timezone conversion ends
 insert into component_sp
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, component_prefix,
 product_code, process_code, insert_dats,
 insert_user_id, patient_id, program_id)
 values
 (:unit_id, :coll_date, :s_chapter_id, :component_prefix,
 :product_code, :process_code, :process_dats, :banner.user_id,
 :patient_id, :banner.prog_name);
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in inserting into component_sp');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_failure
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 go_block('ctrl_blk_2');
 :patient_id := '';
 down;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_UNITCOMP_INTERDICTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_unitcomp_interdiction IS
v_temp number;
temp_label_dats date;
temp_label varchar(4);
BEGIN
begin
 select nvl(label_dats,sysdate-100000), system_label_decision
 into temp_label_dats, temp_label
 from components
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 product_code = :product_code and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 component_status = 'L' and
 reject_reason_code is null and
 ((system_label_decision is not null) or
 (system_label_decision is null and
 :process_code in ('LYMP','GRAN','STEM')));
 
exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
end;
begin
 select nvl(count(*), 0)
 into v_temp
 from component_interdictions ci, valid_interdictions_lab vil, components
 where ci.unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(ci.coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 ci.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 ci.product_code = components.product_code and
 ci.inter_code = vil.inter_code and
 inter_type in ('N','B', 'H') and
 ci.insert_dats >=
 nvl(temp_label_dats,ci.insert_dats-1);

 if v_temp > 0 then
 show_error('0246');
 check_package_failure;
end if;
end;
begin 
 
 select nvl(count(*),0)
 into v_temp
 from unit_interdictions, valid_interdictions_lab vil
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
